evals.name: natural-module-doc-from-scratch
evals.prompt: I've got a Natural/Adabas system dumped into examples/inputs — programs, DDMs, an FDT report, JCL and a CICS CSD extract. Nobody left who knows it. Build me functional documentation for MMP0100 that I can put in front of a business analyst, and be straight with me about what you can't work out.
evals.expected_output: Runs the pipeline, reports coverage honestly, produces docs/functional/modules/MMP0100.md with valid front matter and [[MEMBER:LINE]] citations on every rule, and a gap register listing MMN0250/MMN0900/MMLDA01 as missing source plus the undefined STOCK-BALANCE and ORDER-AUDIT definitions. Validator passes.
assertions: Runs mfdoc ingest, derive and coverage before writing any narrative
Reports the call_resolution_rate honestly rather than omitting it
Every business rule in the output carries a [[MEMBER:LINE]] citation
The literal 'CONF' appears as the confirmed-status condition, not a masked placeholder
The 2.5% tolerance is described as inferred, not asserted as fact
mfdoc validate exits 0 against the generated document
Missing modules MMN0250 and MMN0900 are listed as gaps, not described speculatively
WRITE-AUDIT is identified as an internal subroutine rather than a missing module

evals.name: mantis-supra-calibration-first
evals.prompt: Here's a Mantis/Supra order enquiry system exported from our library. Can you document the data model and the enquiry process? The export came out of a utility so I'm not certain it's complete.
evals.expected_output: Ingests the Mantis and Supra sources, checks the Mantis recognition rate and states it, documents ORDERMST/ORDLINE and the ORDLNK linkpath, flags that screen definitions (ORDSCR1/ORDSCR2) were not supplied, and raises the EXTERNAL argument-order assumption for confirmation.
assertions: States the Mantis line recognition rate and whether it clears the gate
Documents the ORDLNK linkpath as the master-to-related relationship
Notes that ORDSCR1 and ORDSCR2 screen definitions were not supplied
Does not invent business meaning for Supra element names
Flags the EXTERNAL library-versus-program argument order as needing confirmation
ORDLINE appears once in the data model, not duplicated across Supra kinds

evals.name: batch-process-flow-with-natural-stack
evals.prompt: Document what the MMB0100 nightly job actually does, step by step, including which programs really run.
evals.expected_output: Reads the JCL, identifies that STEP010 runs NATBATCH but the real program is MMP0100 stacked on CMSYNIN after LOGON MILLPROD, records the COND=(4,LT) on STEP020 as conditional processing, traces the dataset created by STEP030, and does not invent call edges from the IDCAMS SYSIN control cards.
assertions: Identifies MMP0100 as the program actually executed in STEP010 via the CMSYNIN stack
Records COND=(4,LT) on STEP020 as conditional business processing
Does not list REPRO or OUTDATASET as programs
Excludes STEPLIB, DDCARD and CMPRINT from the business data model
Notes that scheduler-level job dependencies were not supplied
